description: This file defines the 'Autoloader' class within the 'Opencart\System\Engine' namespace. The class is responsible for registering, loading, and autoloading PHP classes based on namespace and directory mappings. It implements an autoloading mechanism compatible with PSR-4 standards, allowing dynamic inclusion of class files within the OpenCart framework.

classes.name: Autoloader
classes.description: Handles autoloading of PHP classes by mapping namespaces to directories, registering classes automatically as needed according to the PSR-4 standard.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Registers the autoload function with SPL autoload registry, setting up class loading via 'load'.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Maps a namespace to a directory with an option for PSR-4 compliance, storing the mapping for later use during class loading.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a class file based on its namespace and class name, according to registered namespace-directory mappings. Includes the file if it exists.
